findings: The plan correctly treats the accepted source08 runtime archive as archival byte authority only and does not upgrade it to complete runtime admission.
The plan does not substitute setup-java, ubuntu-latest, or a Java major version for exact executable/distribution provenance.
All six pre-dispatch bindings are required to be non-null before any export can run.
The plan separates bundle production/reload from MisterTwin Red v0.2 receiving and from final D2 admission.
The plan preserves no-retry semantics for an original export attempt and requires one-time artifact audit.
accepted_scope: The current source08 offline bundle/runtime path is sufficiently specified at the design level to proceed to exact Java-provenance recovery and exact workflow/budget construction.
No Java process, exporter, definition load, bundle, entropy, seed, allocation or game is authorized by this review.
remaining_pre_dispatch_gates: Exact Java executable/distribution/architecture provenance must be recovered from preserved source08 runtime evidence and independently bound.
Exact runtime restore recipe digest must be constructed and reviewed.
Exact export workflow and prospective budget blobs must be constructed and reviewed.
MisterTwin Red v0.2 runtime receiving remains a separate open gate.
prohibited: Do not dispatch the exporter while any pre-dispatch binding is null.
Do not infer current Java byte identity from a hosted runner image or version string.
Do not consume entropy, seeds, allocation state or initialize D2 gameplay.
Do not treat successful bundle export as Red receiving or final D2 admission.
next_gate: Recover and independently bind the exact Java executable/distribution identity recorded by the accepted source08 runtime receipt. In parallel, construct the exact non-executing runtime restore recipe and export workflow/budget without dispatching them.
